evals.prompt: 为智域基石公众号做 3 套机器人触觉主题首图，输出横版和方图，保持主体一致，最后放官方 Logo 和标题。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses AIFlow GPT Image for generated masters, separates Logo/text composition, records candidates and delivers variants with VI release QA.
expectations: Does not ask the model to generate the official Logo or final text.
Uses separate n=1 requests for a bounded candidate set.
Creates deterministic crop variants and records provenance.

evals.prompt: 用 AIFlow 做一组保持同一机器人角色和工业场景风格的四张活动海报底图，并说明每轮修改依据。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a consistency dossier, notes current reference-image limitations, uses controlled prompt iterations and records selected outputs and hypotheses.
expectations: Changes named variables rather than vague make-it-better iterations.
Reports that current AIFlow generations do not guarantee reference-image consistency.

evals.prompt: Generate a campaign master through AIFlow and save the exact image into this project. If the delivery UI does not display the completed result, recover the exact completed artifact without generating again.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the AIFlow gpt-image-2 adapter, applies the absorbed imagegen prompt workflow, decodes and validates the exact Base64 artifact, and treats missing display as a delivery issue rather than a reason to regenerate.
expectations: Uses AIFlow gpt-image-2 as the current verified production adapter.
Does not silently switch to another provider or model.
Does not regenerate when a completed result exists but UI delivery failed.
Saves the exact bitmap to a workspace path and records provenance.

evals.prompt: Add support for a future non-GPT text-to-image model without claiming features that have not been tested.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates an unsupported model-adapter record, leaves implementation empty, and requires live positive evidence and fail-closed negative controls before verification.
expectations: Does not infer compatibility from an OpenAI-like API shape.
Records capability booleans, limits, output transport and retry/billing behavior.
Keeps the provider unsupported until verified evidence exists.
